items.text: You cannot control what happens. You can control how you answer it.
The obstacle is not in your way. The obstacle is the way.
Judge less. Understand more. Most pain comes from the story we add.
Do today what a calm mind would be proud of tomorrow.
Wealth is wanting little. Peace is needing less.
Begin each morning by expecting difficulty, and meet it without surprise.
Anger costs more than the thing that caused it.
You do not rise to your goals. You act from your habits.
Look at the tasks in front of you. Do the next right thing.
Be the same person in private as you are in public.
Time is the one thing you cannot earn back. Spend it like it matters.
Another person's opinion of you is their business, not yours.
